claim: Tomar entre 300 y 500 ml de agua ayuda a elevar la tensión arterial.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Split (part 2 of 2). Oyewunmi et al. 2023 (JAHA), a systematic review and meta-analysis of a rapid 350-500 mL water bolus: systolic BP +24 mmHg in orthostatic hypotension, +2.3 mmHg in healthy participants. 300 against 350 mL is within reasonable rounding (rule 2). Mathias & Young 2004 (Eur J Neurol): ~500 mL raises BP in older people and much more in autonomic failure, not in healthy young people - real, but small for most healthy readers.
